headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 16 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, FOH, TPi and 11 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: Martin Audio Leads Sonic Upgrade At Historic Michigan Church
items.take: Integration firm BC Sound implements new system utilizing a O-Line compact array to support growing use of live music during services at First Presbyterian Church in Battle Creek.

items.title: Track Pin In Pro Tools For Audio Post
items.take: The larger a Pro Tools session gets, the more scrolling you inevitably have to do in order to locate the tracks you need to work on. This is especially a problem in large post-production sessions where track counts can easily run into the hundreds and beyond.

items.take: IK Multimedia have just announced the launch of Parametric Tone Models, a new technology that captures not only the sound of guitar amps and pedals, but also how their controls respond and interact.

items.title: Production Futures launches Switched On Campaign

items.title: MTHRBORD releases ACL2500, a FREE API 2500-style bus compressor
items.take: MTHRBORD.STUDIO has released ACL2500, a free stereo VCA bus compressor for macOS and Windows, modeled from measurements and recordings of a real API 2500. The developer measured how the hardware responds across different threshold, ratio, attack, release, and knee settings.

craft.body:
The HSE findings are a useful mirror: most failures were not missing earplugs but plugs worn badly, taken out mid-shift or so effective that people could not hear alarms. A roll-down foam plug that is only half inserted can give a fraction of its labelled rating.

Before a loud shift, fit plugs properly (roll, pull the ear up and back, hold until expanded) and do a quick check: your own voice should sound boomy and the room noticeably duller. Then confirm you can still hear comms and the venue alarm. For mixing, a custom moulded set with flat filters keeps the balance honest at a lower level, and lets you leave them in all day.
craft.title: Check your plugs, not just your levels
